attractions.name: Machu Picchu Coinino
attractions.description: Formaciones de piedra imponentes en lo alto de las montañas que se asemejan al famoso santuario incaico, ofreciendo vistas espectaculares del valle de Coina y el río Alto Chicama.
attractions.accessibility: Caminata de 30 minutos desde el cementerio de Coina.

attractions.name: Mirador de Coina
attractions.description: Ubicado en la parte alta donde antes se situaba la antena de TV. Permite contemplar por completo la población y la campiña de Coina, destacando todos sus sectores.
attractions.accessibility: Acceso caminando o en vehículo ligero desde el centro.

attractions.name: Río Alto Chicama (Río Grande)
attractions.description: Río de aguas cristalinas que decora el paisaje del valle. Históricamente ha sido punto de esparcimiento para lavar ropa, frazadas y mote, y un refrescante lugar de baño.
attractions.accessibility: Caminata corta descendiendo desde el sector La Fundición.

attractions.name: Estadio Municipal de Coina
attractions.description: Recinto deportivo recientemente mejorado que cuenta con una moderna cobertura metálica techada para proteger a las familias del intenso sol o de lluvias pasajeras.
attractions.accessibility: Ubicado a pocas cuadras de la plaza principal.

attractions.name: Casa Campestre Luna Park
attractions.description: Sitio recreativo familiar con piscinas refrescantes, canchas de fútbol para jugar al aire libre, restaurante campestre y maravillosas vistas panorámicas.

attractions.name: La Hostería Coina
attractions.description: Histórica propiedad de la familia del médico alemán Dr. Oswaldo Kauffman, rodeada de naturaleza con piscinas, juegos rústicos y mesas de madera.
attractions.accessibility: Ubicada muy cerca del Puesto de Salud de Coina.

accommodations.name: Hospedaje La Huaca
accommodations.description: Descanso tranquilo en un ambiente familiar y rústico con precios muy accesibles.

accommodations.name: Hotel Rossy
accommodations.description: Cómodo y seguro, ideal para familias y viajeros que buscan confort en el centro del pueblo.

restaurants.name: Recreo Doña Mili
restaurants.address: Frente a la Plaza de Coina
restaurants.featured_dish: Cuy frito crocante y chancho frito

restaurants.name: Pizzería Delicia
restaurants.address: A un costado de la Iglesia San Miguel
restaurants.featured_dish: Pizza de masa artesanal con hierbas andinas

products.name: Limas Dulces de Coina
products.description: Limas recolectadas directamente de los huertos familiares de Coina, la Capital de la Lima Dulce. Cítrico aromático, rico en Vitamina C y bajo en acidez.

products.name: Mermelada de Lima Dulce
products.description: Elaborada artesanalmente por agricultores locales con limas seleccionadas y endulzada de forma natural.

products.name: Vino de Lima Dulce
products.description: Bebida fermentada única con el aroma sutil y dulce de nuestra fruta bandera. Un deleite para ocasiones especiales.

attractions.name: Machu Picchu of Coina
attractions.description: Imposing stone formations high in the mountains that resemble the famous Inca sanctuary, offering spectacular views of the Coina valley and the Alto Chicama River.
attractions.accessibility: A 30-minute walk from the Coina cemetery.

attractions.name: Coina Viewpoint
attractions.description: Located on the upper part where the old TV antenna was situated. It allows a complete view of the town and countryside of Coina, highlighting all its sectors.
attractions.accessibility: Accessible by walking or light vehicle from the town center.

attractions.name: Alto Chicama River (Río Grande)
attractions.description: Crystal clear river that decorates the valley's landscape. Historically, it has been a recreational spot to wash clothes, blankets, and hominy (mote), and a refreshing swimming spot.
attractions.accessibility: Short downhill walk from La Fundición sector.

attractions.name: Coina Municipal Stadium
attractions.description: Recently improved sports facility featuring a modern metal roof to protect families from intense sun or passing rain.
attractions.accessibility: Located a few blocks from the main square.

attractions.name: Luna Park Country House
attractions.description: Family recreational site with refreshing pools, open-air football fields, a country restaurant, and wonderful panoramic views.

attractions.name: The Coina Country Guesthouse (La Hostería)
attractions.description: Historic property belonging to the family of the German physician Dr. Oswaldo Kauffman, surrounded by nature with swimming pools, rustic games, and wooden tables.
attractions.accessibility: Located very close to the Coina Health Post.

accommodations.name: La Huaca Guesthouse
accommodations.description: Tranquil rest in a family and rustic atmosphere with highly affordable prices.

accommodations.name: Rossy Hotel
accommodations.description: Comfortable and secure, ideal for families and travelers seeking comfort in the center of town.

restaurants.name: Dona Mili Country Restaurant
restaurants.address: In front of the Coina Main Square
restaurants.featured_dish: Crispy fried guinea pig and deep-fried pork

restaurants.name: Delicia Pizzeria
restaurants.address: Next to the San Miguel Church
restaurants.featured_dish: Artisanal crust pizza with Andean herbs

products.name: Coina Sweet Limes
products.description: Limes harvested directly from Coina's family orchards, the Capital of the Sweet Lime. Aromatic citrus, rich in Vitamin C and low in acidity.

products.name: Sweet Lime Jam
products.description: Handcrafted by local farmers with selected sweet limes and naturally sweetened.

products.name: Sweet Lime Wine
products.description: Unique fermented beverage with the subtle and sweet aroma of our flagship fruit. A delight for special occasions.
